//: BrainPilot custom model providers — copy to your data dir and point BP_MODELS_JSON at it.
//provider: By default the FIRST provider below is used. Set BP_MODEL_PROVIDER=<name> to pick another.
//keys: apiKey supports $ENV interpolation — e.g. "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" reads the env var at request time. Never inline secrets here if this file is committed.
//docs: Full schema (api types, compat flags, headers, cost): https://pi.dev/docs/latest/models

providers.//openai-example: An OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio). Switch BP_MODEL_PROVIDER to this name to use it.
providers.//compat-example: Use `compat` flags when the gateway diverges from real Anthropic on tool streaming / thinking signatures.
